text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to extend the existing no standing anytime regulation on the north side of Floyd Avenue between Pape Avenue and a point 20 metres west, to be in effect from Pape Avenue and a point 38 metres west. This is in response to a concern received from Solid Waste Management Services regarding access issues to the first laneway west of Pape Avenue, north of Floyd Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited standing at all times on the north side of Floyd Avenue, between a point 20 metres west of Pape Avenue and a point 18 metres further west. 2. Amended the existing parking machine regulation in effect on the north side of Floyd Avenue, between Carlaw Avenue and Pape Avenue, from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Saturday, to operate on the north side of Floyd Avenue, between a point 38 metres west of Pape Avenue and a point 18 metres further west.
